title: Account Types & Suitability

items.Key Features: One owner; assets pass via will/probate at death
Equal undivided interest; survivor takes 100%; bypasses probate; common spouses
Specified % interest; decedent's share to estate (NOT survivor); for unequal owners
One minor, one custodian; irrevocable gift; taxed to minor (kiddie tax); UTMA allows more asset types & later age of majority
Grantor can amend/revoke; assets in grantor's estate; avoids probate
Cannot be changed; assets removed from grantor estate; separate TIN
Corp resolution + charter required; identify auth. persons; margin needs charter authorization
Partnership agreement required; must be amended annually if margin

items.Tax: Pre-tax contrib; ordinary income on withdrawal; no age cap on contrib (SECURE Act)
After-tax; qualified withdrawals tax-free; AGI phase-out applies; no RMDs for owner

items.Limit 2026: Lesser of 25% comp or IRS cap

sections.heading: IRA/Plan Rules (post-SECURE 2.0)
items: Early withdrawal penalty: 10% if <59½ (exceptions: 1st home $10K, higher ed, death, disability, medical, SEPP 72(t))
RMD age = 73 (rising to 75 for those turning 74 after 12/31/2032)
RMD failure penalty = 25% of shortfall (10% if corrected timely)
Roth IRA: no RMD for original owner; 5-year rule for qualified distributions
Rollover: 60-day rule; one indirect rollover per 12 months; trustee-to-trustee unlimited
Contributions allowed up to tax filing deadline (April 15) for prior year
IRA prohibited investments: collectibles, life insurance, most metals (gold/silver eagles OK)

sections.heading: Cash vs Margin (Reg T / FINRA 4210)
items: Reg T initial margin = 50% of purchase (Fed Reserve)
FINRA minimum equity: $2,000 long; short account also $2,000 min
Maintenance: 25% long / 30% short (FINRA 4210)
Pattern Day Trader: 4+ day trades in 5 business days → $25,000 min equity required
Margin docs: Credit Agreement (required), Hypothecation Agreement (required), Loan Consent (optional)
Margin disclosure statement delivered at account opening and annually (FINRA 2264)
Cash account: full payment by S+1 (Reg T) — no borrowing; IRAs/UGMA/UTMA must be CASH only

items.Features: State-sponsored; high contrib limits; tax-free qualified ed withdrawals; donor retains control; 5-yr gift-tax election available; K-12 up to $10K/yr
$2,000/yr max; AGI phase-out; beneficiary <18; must use by age 30; K-12 + higher ed
For individuals disabled before age 26; tax-free growth for qualified disability expenses; does not disqualify SSI/Medicaid (within limits)
Custodial; irrevocable gift; not education-restricted; counts heavily in financial aid

sections.heading: Discretionary vs Non-Discretionary
items: Discretion = RM chooses Asset, Action, or Amount (the 3 A's) without prior contact
Requires: written customer authorization + firm acceptance BEFORE first discretionary trade
Each discretionary order marked 'discretionary'; principal must review promptly
Price and Time alone are NOT discretion (not-held order)
Exchange member discretionary trades regulated under Exchange Act §11(d)/§11(a)(1)(H)
Excessive trading in discretionary account = churning (prohibited, Rule 2010/2020)

sections.heading: KYC & Suitability (FINRA 2090 / 2111 / Reg BI 15l-1)
items: Rule 2090 KYC: use reasonable diligence to know essential facts re every customer and persons with authority over account
Rule 2111 Suitability — 3 obligations: (1) Reasonable-basis, (2) Customer-specific, (3) Quantitative
Customer-specific factors: age, other investments, financial situation/needs, tax status, objectives, experience, time horizon, liquidity needs, risk tolerance
Reg BI (17 CFR 240.15l-1): broker-dealers must act in retail customer's best interest at time of recommendation; 4 obligations — Disclosure, Care, Conflict of Interest, Compliance
Form CRS (17 CFR 240.17a-14) delivered to retail investors at/before recommendation or account opening
New account form (Rule 4512): name, DOB, SSN/TIN, occupation/employer, citizenship, signature of registered rep & principal; trusted contact required to be requested

sections.heading: Account Opening Requirements
items: CIP (PATRIOT Act §326): name, DOB, address, SSN/TIN — verify identity
Principal approval required BEFORE first trade (signature not required from customer to open cash account)
Records retention (17 CFR 240.17a-3/17a-4): account records kept life of account + 6 years; some 3 years
Customer signature required for: margin agreement, options agreement (within 15 days), discretionary authorization

common_traps: JTWROS vs TIC: JTWROS → survivor gets all; TIC → decedent's share goes to estate. Unmarried unequal owners typically use TIC.
UGMA/UTMA is IRREVOCABLE and assets belong to the MINOR; cannot be margin; one custodian/one minor per account.
RMD age is 73 (NOT 72) and penalty is 25% (NOT 50%) under SECURE 2.0 — old SIE prep books are stale.
Discretion = A/A/A (Asset, Action, Amount). Choosing only Price/Time = NOT discretion. Written auth must precede first discretionary trade.
Roth IRA owner has NO RMD during lifetime; Traditional IRA does. Both now allow contributions at any age (post-SECURE).
